note: Expected conditions are author-labelled from standard crop-pathology references. A case passes if ANY expected keyword appears in the diagnosis section.

text_cases.text: Tomato lower leaves have brown spots with concentric dark rings and yellow halos, older leaves dying first.
Dark water-soaked patches on tomato leaves with white fuzzy growth underneath, spreading very fast after rain.
White powdery coating on the upper side of my squash leaves, leaves turning yellow and drying.
Orange-brown powdery pustules on wheat leaves that rub off on my fingers.
Rice leaves have diamond-shaped spots with grey centre and brown border, some neck of panicle turned black.
Tomato leaves curl upward and turn yellow at the edges, plants are stunted, many whiteflies on the plants.
Rice leaves show yellow wavy margins starting at the tips, drying out, seedlings wilting.
Potato tubers have rough brown scabby corky patches on the skin.
Tomato fruits have a dark sunken leathery patch at the bottom end opposite the stem.
Cucumber leaves have yellow angular patches with purple-grey fuzz on the underside.
Chilli leaves are curled upward and crinkled, tiny insects on the underside, sticky honeydew on leaves.
White powdery growth on wheat leaves and stems, getting grey-brown later.
Rice leaf sheath has oval greenish-grey lesions with brown border looking like snake skin pattern.
Whole tomato plant is wilting while leaves stay green, and the inside of the stem is brown.
Potato lower leaves yellowing with small dry brown spots showing concentric rings.
Maize leaves have long grey-tan rectangular lesions between the veins.
Brinjal leaves are full of tiny round holes and I can see small black jumping beetles.
Cabbage leaves have many holes and I found green caterpillars hiding on the leaves.
Older tomato leaves are uniformly pale yellow, growth is slow and plants are weak.
Young maize plants are stunted with purple tint on leaf edges.
Edges of older tomato leaves are scorched brown and curling.
Tomato has small dark spots with yellow halo on leaves and raised scabby spots on fruit.
Small circular spots with grey centres and dark borders with tiny black dots on lower tomato leaves.
Rice seedlings have oval brown spots on leaves with yellow halo.
Wheat ear heads are replaced by black powdery masses.
Potato leaves roll upward, plants are stunted and there are many aphids.
Chilli fruits have dark sunken circular spots with concentric rings.
Cabbage leaves have V-shaped yellow lesions starting at the leaf edge with blackened veins.
Tomato fruits have round holes and a caterpillar is inside the fruit.
Brinjal shoot tips are wilting and fruits have bore holes with excreta.
